subject: general
question: Identify the correct chemical reaction involved in bleaching powder preparation

options.text: NaCl + H₂O + CO₂ + NH₃ → NH₄Cl + NaHCO₃
NaHCO₃ + H⁺→ CO₂ + H₂O + Sodium salt of acid

solution:
The correct answer is **'__Ca(OH)2 + Cl2 → CaOCl2 + H2____O__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bleaching powder** is** Calcium oxychloride (CaOCl₂ ).** It is prepared by** passing chlorine gas over dry slaked lime( Ca(OH)₂).**
 
• **Reaction**: Ca(OH)2 + Cl2 → CaOCl2 + H2O

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Uses :**

 
• For bleaching cotton and linen in textile industry
 
• As an oxidising agent in a chemical industry.
 
• For disinfecting water.
